name: Agentic Research Network
purpose: Potentially coordinate and reward verifiable AI and product research for named products.
value_promise: Contributors and funders can inspect research questions, novelty, runs, findings, attribution and proposed economics under explicit rules.

includes: Research program disclosure and versioned evidence
Proposed work rewards and research participation accounting
excludes: Automatic scientific priority or product validation
Automatic IP ownership or employer hiring authority

claim_ceiling: Candidate Product identity only; no released network, admitted product or token.
